description: Chart-pin currency for the ApplicationSet catalog. Renovate watches every Helm chart version pinned in applicationsets/ (and the git-pinned Gateway API CRDs) and opens a PR when a newer release ships — the helm-render + schema CI gates then validate each bump before merge. Restricted to chart + git-tag managers so it never overlaps the github-actions updates dependabot owns.

customManagers.description: HTTPS Helm chart pins in ApplicationSet matrix list elements (chartRepo/chart/chartVersion), which the argocd manager cannot resolve because they are templated onto the source.
OCI Helm chart pins in ApplicationSet matrix list elements. The registry path already carries the chart name for every pin except the NVIDIA DRA driver, which is auth-gated and updated out of band.

Git-pinned Gateway API CRDs (gateway-api-crds.yaml). A plain manifest directory (config/crd/standard) sourced from a git tag, not a Helm chart, so neither the argocd manager nor the chart regex managers above can resolve it. Watched against the upstream GitHub release tags so a currency PR opens and runs the render + schema gates; the deliberate-bump rationale in the file still governs the merge decision.
